findings.fix: Add `tensorPowerRep_apply (g : GL (Fin n) k) : tensorPowerRep k n d g = PiTensorProduct.map fun _ : Fin d => Matrix.mulVecLin (g : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) k)` to `ClassicalGroups/TensorPower.lean` (next to `commute_permTensorAction_tensorPowerRep`, which opens with the same `rw [tensorPowerRep, Representation.tensorPower_apply]` step) and rewrite with it at all three sites.
findings.issue: `tensorPowerRep k n d g = map (fun _ => mulVecLin ↑g)` is re-derived ad hoc three times in this file: twice by `simp [Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.coe_toLin]` (lines 80, 84) and once by `simpa only [tensorPowerRep, Representation.tensorPower_apply, stdRep_apply]` (line 134), the last unfolding the `tensorPowerRep` abbrev inside `simp only`.

summary: Proofs are short, robust, and free of `change`/`show` or defeq abuse, but two facts are re-proved inline instead of being factored: the centralizer-vs-permutation criterion is copied verbatim from `SchurWeyl.lean`, and the diagonal description of `tensorPowerRep` is re-derived by automation three times.
